description: Two-panel meme built from a CNN 'Fareed Zakaria GPS' broadcast screenshot of Hillary Clinton, with a chyron about her reaction to the Harvey Weinstein accusations, paired with a zoomed-in crop of the pendant necklace she is wearing. Overlaid caption text claims the pendant is a 'satanic cross'; that characterization is the meme's unverified claim. A partial filename 'Iy95pC3.jpg' is visible at the bottom edge.
text: ZAKARIA. BREAKING NEWS. CLINTON ON WEINSTEIN ACCUSATIONS: "I WAS JUST SICK". CNN. 7:02 PM ET. GPS. FAREED ZAKARIA. NOTE THE SATANIC CROSS SHE WEARS. Iy95pC3.jpg
flags: Caption's claim that the pendant is a 'satanic cross' is an unverified interpretation by the meme creator; the pendant's actual design is blurry and not clearly identifiable
